sections.title: Dashboard cards

sections.title: Checklist widget body

sections.title: WidgetCard

sections.title: Link list widget body
sections.purpose: Shows a link list widget body with editable title, entries with titles and web addresses that open on choose, and title plus address fields with Add action, autosaved with validation and retry.

sections.title: Add widget dialog
sections.purpose: Shows selectable type options for note, counter, checklist and link list with Cancel and Add actions, marks missing type as required and offers retry on failure.

sections.purpose: Names the widget to remove, says its checklist items or links go with it, and offers Cancel and permanent Remove actions.

newComponents.name: WidgetBoard
newComponents.purpose: Arrange a dashboard's widgets by relative order and small/medium/large size on a glowing grid.
newComponents.whyNotExisting: CardGroup has no size-aware responsive grid or faint neon backdrop, and FlexScrollArea has no ordering and sizing logic for widgets.
newComponents.description: A full-width canvas that holds all WidgetCards in relative order on a dark base with a faint cyan grid behind them. It is low-emphasis background for focus, with soft radius, comfortable density, Inter for helper text and JetBrains Mono for timestamps, and subtle neon edge glow; like the mission-control board of a sci-fi console app.

nodes.text: Drag to reorder. Pick a size.

nodes.what: faint cyan grid with neon edge glow

nodes.text: No widgets yet. Add your first block.

newComponents.name: WidgetCard
newComponents.purpose: Contain one widget with its title, size and position controls and its type content.
newComponents.whyNotExisting: Card and Section lack inline title editing, small/medium/large variants, move and resize controls, and neon header treatment.
newComponents.description: A bordered tile with a glowing header row holding editable title, move, resize and remove controls, and a type-specific body for note, counter, checklist or link list. It is medium-emphasis on the dark base with cyan/magenta neon border, soft radius, Space Grotesk title, Inter body and JetBrains Mono for counter figures, comfortable density; like an instrument-panel tile in a spaceship dashboard app.

questions.question: Should a counter widget's number have a minimum, maximum, or step other than changing by 1 with no limits?
questions.whyItMatters: Determines whether decrease below zero is allowed and whether stepper needs disabled states or validation.
questions.defaultAnswer: The counter has no minimum or maximum and can be decreased below zero, changing by 1 each time.
